structure:
1) Name the exact moment of resistance the viewer is in right now.
2) Why the usual advice fails there.
3) One reframe, stated once, plainly.
4) A concrete action small enough to do today.
5) Return to the opening moment, changed.
voice: SECOND person, PRESENT tense. Short declaratives. No lists, no “top five”. Earn every imperative — at most one command per chapter.
invention: Use only real examples; never invent a person’s story or attribute a quote that was not said.
